body: Rebased and converted to draft, currently trying to see if it can slightly faster with single thread

After some experiments found an easier way to keep the same uncontended `ObjectDB::get_instance` multi-threading speed, unrelated objects shouldn't get in each others way when being accessed through `ObjectDB`. Also much faster multi-threaded slot reuse for native objects. The GDScript instances are under another global mutex, so they don't benefit.

But I couldn't bring single-threaded performance on par with the master, `ObjectDB::get_instance` now is really close to it almost the same, but addition and removal together aren't (I'm not sure which of them is slow).
